title: The Maintenance-notifications setting is a live customer toggle
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a service advisor with view and edit customers, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (behind the maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. An asset that has a customer, and a schedule to enrol it on. Seed them:
  3. ↳ Ensure a schedule exists (Settings > Maintenance > New schedule + at least one service).
  4. ↳ Open an asset that has a customer (from Customers > a customer > Assets, or from Work Orders) and open its Maintenance tab (the last tab on the asset page).
  5. A customer with several enrolled units; be able to open the customer information card and the enrolment modal.
custom_steps:
1. In the enrolment modal find "Send preventive maintenance notifications" and change it there.
  2. On the customer information card find the "Maintenance notifications" toggle; confirm it is not in the customer edit dialog.
  3. Turn it off and read what it states about affected units; check a customer whose setting is on but who has no email.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The enrolment modal shows the customer's "Send preventive maintenance notifications" setting and lets it be changed there (writing the customer's own field); enrolling an asset and enrolling a customer in notifications are two separate acts.
  • The setting is on by default for existing and new customers; it lives on the customer as a live toggle "Maintenance notifications" on the customer information card and as a checkbox in the modal - not in the customer edit dialog, not a tab/page/matrix; one value covers every unit that customer owns.
  • Turning it off states how many of that customer's enrolled units will not receive reminders; a customer whose setting is on but has no email on file receives nothing, and every surface says so where it applies.
  • Changing it follows the permission to edit a customer; it is not financial data and does not sit behind the AP/AR visibility gate.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; story SV-10564 (S7, Enrol an asset onto a schedule); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), S7; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-R13: “The enrolment modal will show the customer's Send preventive maintenance notifications setting and let it be changed there, writing the customer's own field”
  • S7-R14: “Enrolling an asset on a schedule and enrolling a customer in notifications are two separate acts”
  • S7-R17: “The setting is on by default, for existing and new customers alike”
  • S7-R18: “The field lives on the customer as a live toggle, Maintenance notifications, on the customer information card, and as a checkbox in the enrolment modal ... It is not in the customer edit dialog, and it is not a tab, a page or a preferences matrix”
  • S7-R19: “Turning it off will state how many of that customer's enrolled units will not receive reminders”
  • S7-R20: “A customer whose setting is on but who has no email address on file receives nothing. Every surface that shows the setting says so where it applies”
  • S7-R21: “One value covers every unit that customer owns, including units enrolled after it was set”
  • S7-R22: “Changing it follows the permission to edit a customer. It is not financial data and does not sit behind the AP and AR visibility gate”
